subject: history_text: public-track files are *_timesplit.jsonl
body: Thanks for 5582308/d81c135. The public-track files are data/researchers/<slug>/history_timesplit.jsonl and heldout_timesplit.jsonl (not history.jsonl), so R1-S still gets no history from history_text. Could it also read history_timesplit.jsonl? Hobbhahn's is pushed (373 rows).
